title: Data imports
description: Load your plant from Excel or CSV files: checked before anything is written, the reason for every refused line, downloadable template.

guide.title: In which order should data be loaded?
guide.intro: Each import builds on the previous one: an unknown code is refused, never created automatically.
guide.s0: 1. Reference lists (Reference data > Import): classes, families, units, priorities, failure causes…
guide.s3: 4. Personnel, then teams and skills (Personnel > Import).
guide.s5: 6. Warehouses, articles, suppliers and opening stock.
guide.s6: 7. Preventive plans (they arrive as drafts, a planner publishes them).
guide.s7: 8. History: past work orders and failures (so reliability indicators do not start empty).
guide.rules: Common rules: running the same file again updates without creating duplicates; an import never deletes what is missing from the file; an empty cell stays empty.
